thread:
oncall-bot: ALERT fired — /api/v1/generate 5xx-rate elevated across hosted cluster (p50 latency normal, p99 spikes). severity=high, current_window=5m, burn_rate=3.2x :rotating_light:
Elena R: seeing a lot of 502/503s, client retries piling up. I’m on it — checking upstream pool and recent deploys.
Sam K: I’ll pull traces and key logs. earliest spikes ~21:12 UTC. Any change since the 21:00 deploy?
Mike T: 21:00 deploy was config-only (autoscaler tweak) — no code. rolling back autoscaler now to previous config.
Elena R: rollback started. will tail ingress logs.
deploy-bot: Rollback of deployment/inference-hosted/scale-config initiated by Mike T — rolling to revision r2023-10-11a.
Elena R: after rollback error rate dropping slightly but still above threshold. Could be overload from a few noisy tenants. tagging product for customer-impact check.
Jess P: notifying support ops to triage affected tenants and surface any active incidents.
Sam K: traces show increased upstream 502s from redis-ish cache layer; connections saturating at ~90% of pool. I’m bumping connection pool and opening a temporary circuit-breaker for a small subset of routes.
Elena R: launching quick mitigation: add per-tenant rate cap for the high fanout route and enable prefix-KV cache warm for that path.
Mike T: applied conn pool bump + ephemeral circuit-breaker for route /v1/chat_stream. watch for regressions.
ops-bot: Pager muted for alert group "5xx-rate-hosted-low-urgency" for 30m by Elena R — reason: active mitigation in progress :white_check_mark:
Sam K: note — this is where paging criteria need to be stricter. 5m window is too jittery for downstream transient blips. Suggest multi-window logic: trigger page when burn >2x for 15m AND peak >5x for 5m.
Elena R: agree. For now we have a temporary silence to avoid pager fatigue while mitigation stabilizes. make a follow-up to formalize rule.
Jess P: customer-impact: Support Ops reports 3 customers with increased error rates; all have automatic retry in SDKs. No payment-impact customers yet. Opening support ticket: SUP-5421.
Sam K: creating incident timeline in the incident doc now. Will attach sample traces and the redis connection metrics.
Elena R: quick postmortem note: root cause likely connection pool pacing + a small traffic spike from one partner that fanouts heavy requests.
Mike T: infrastructure follow-up: autoscaler policy reverted, adding smoother ramp (scale_cooldown from 30s -> 90s) to avoid oscillation.
Sam K: alert tuning proposal (will file a PR against prometheus-alerts):
```
# from:
- alert: HostedFiveXXRateHigh
  expr: job:5xx:rate5m > 0.01
  for: 5m
# to (proposal):
- alert: HostedFiveXXRateHigh
  expr: job:5xx:rate5m > 0.01
  for: 15m
  annotations:
    summary: "Sustained 5xx rate on hosted endpoints (multi-window)" )
- alert: HostedFiveXXSpike
  expr: job:5xx:rate1m > 0.05
  for: 5m
  severity: page
```
Sam K: basically split into sustained-window (alerts to slack only) vs short high-spike (pages). reduces noise and catches both modes.
Elena R: also add a burn-budget check: only page if projected SLO burn > 1.5x in 6h window. prevents paging for tiny short-lived bursts.
Jess P: create a dashboard tile for projected SLO-burn and tenant-level top offenders. we need a clear signal in the console for oncall.
Elena R: temporary mitigation holding — error rate back to ~1.2x baseline. I’ll handoff in 25m to Sam (end of shift). leave notes in the incident doc.
Sam K: thanks — I’ll take over. action items: (1) PR alert rule changes, (2) add tenant-level SLO burn widget, (3) run a short load test against fanout route with current autoscaler settings.
Mike T: infra tickets: INF-3309 autoscaler cooldown change, INF-3310 connection pool telemetry for redis clients.
Jess P: support ticket updated with mitigation notes and ETA for rollback.
Elena R: one more ops note — we should also consider adding temporary rate-limiter per-tenant for the next deploy if we see repeat offenders.
Sam K: acknowledged. I’ll create a followup RFC for multi-window paging criteria + burn budget policy and tag oncall and product. Drafting now: RFC-1157.
Elena R: handing off: Sam owns wakeup criteria and dashboard follow-ups. leaving a compact checklist in incident doc. Good job team. :raised_hands:
ops-bot: Incident status changed to MONITORING — updates will be posted to this thread.
Sam K: logging final metrics snapshot to the incident doc and tagging metrics owner for a post-incident review. Closing handover at 21:36 UTC.
Elena R: thanks — signing off.
